changeSet.sql: BEGIN IF COL_LENGTH('[dbo].[Artifact]','ParentID') IS NOT NULL BEGIN IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE name='IX_Artifact_ParentID' AND object_id = OBJECT_ID('[dbo].[Artifact]')) BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_Artifact_ParentID] ON [dbo].[Artifact] END IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS WHERE CONSTRAINT_NAME ='FK_Artifact_ParentArtifact') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Artifact] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_Artifact_ParentArtifact] END ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Artifact] DROP Column ParentID END END
